newsitem.title: USA: SITEL wins American Express contract.
newsitem.headline: SITEL wins American Express contract.

text.p: SITEL Corp said Tuesday it received a three-year contract to provide telemarketing services in Australia to a unit of American Express Co.
The agreement covers inbound and outbound customer telemarketing, card acquisitions, card activation and handling of direct response generated by television ads, SITEL said.
The pact is SITEL's first since its acquisition of the parent of Levita Group, Australia's leading teleservicing company, last month.
SITEL provides telephone-based customer service and sales programs.
Its shares were up 1/4 Tuesday at 14-1/2.
